_gemini_part.text:
The incident (ID 1) occurred because the `eat_memory` task in the `drill_oom` DAG exceeded its 128Mi memory limit and was terminated by Kubernetes (`OOMKilled`).

I have recorded the diagnosis as a `platform_resources` failure and proposed steps from Runbook 10 (`10-oomkilled`) for handling tasks that run out of memory. These steps include evaluating whether the input data size is unusually large, potentially increasing the task's memory limit, and clearing the failed pod after resolution.
